annotation.title_clean: Adenda. Segunda Fase del Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia del Reino de España. Impulso a la Industrialización Estratégica
annotation.venue: Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia (planderecuperacion.gob.es)
annotation.summary_en: Spain's September 2023 Addendum to its Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan, a captured document filed under the National AI Strategy (ENIA) page. It sets out second-phase investments and reforms on strategic autonomy, industrialisation, energy transition and REPowerEU, with audit and control arrangements. AI and robotics governance are not substantively treated in the excerpt.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends the Recovery Plan to 2026 with added investments and reforms for strategic autonomy and industrialisation.
Accelerates renewables, sustainable mobility and energy efficiency in line with REPowerEU.
Sets multi-level control and audit arrangements and transparency requirements for fund execution.
Keeps four cross-cutting axes: green, digital, gender equality, and social and territorial cohesion.
The excerpt contains no AI- or robot-specific provisions despite the ENIA page label.
